title: Northgate Retail Bank Credit Policy: Combined Credit Line Across Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Accounts
content:
**Policy statement.** The credit lines of all of a customer's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts in active or restricted status are aggregated. Neither an approval nor a credit line change may bring the sum of those credit lines above USD 60000.00. When the full amount the card's own rules would allow does not fit, the new or increased line is reduced to the amount that fits, and when less than USD 100.00 fits, no increase is made. Closed, charged-off and declined accounts do not count toward the sum.

**Effect on the accounts' own terms.** Holding both a private-label and a co-brand account changes nothing else in either account's terms: each account keeps its own APR, fees, statement and status ladder.

## The test in parts

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Accounts counted | every card account of the customer in active or restricted status |
| Accounts not counted | closed, charged-off and declined accounts |
| Ceiling | the sum of the counted credit lines never above USD 60000.00 |
| Full amount does not fit | the new or increased line is reduced to the amount that fits |
| Less than USD 100.00 fits | no increase is made |

## Worked cases (hypothetical lines)

1. A customer holds an active Store Card with a line of USD 8000.00 and an active World Elite Mastercard with a line of USD 48000.00; the counted sum is USD 56000.00, so USD 4000.00 fits. An increase of USD 5000.00 that the World Elite Mastercard's own rules would allow is reduced to USD 4000.00.
2. The same customer with lines summing to USD 59950.00: USD 50.00 fits, less than USD 100.00, so no increase is made.
3. A customer whose second account is closed: its line does not count toward the sum.
4. An application approved for a customer whose active account already has a line of USD 55000.00: no more than USD 5000.00 fits, and the new account's line is reduced to an amount that fits.
